title: Boundary Adjustments in Designated Open Space
previewText:

blocks.plainText: The City Planning Commission may grant special permits to allow adjustments in the boundaries of the designated open space on a zoning lot provided that such adjustment will not place the new boundary closer than 60 feet to a watercourse. As a condition for such adjustment in the boundaries, the Commission shall find that such adjustment will:

blocks.html: (a)        result in a substantial improvement in the quality and usefulness of the designated open space; or
